# PowerLink v1.0.0 — unified PowerPlay/PowerLink branding

## Changes in this release

- Introduce the official PowerLink cyan/blue interlocking-link and lightning identity, with vector source, high-contrast variants, and Home Assistant integration branding.
- Refresh the README hero and release presentation to distinguish PowerLink from the PowerPlay player app.
- Retain the existing Home Assistant integration domain, service names, paired devices, PowerShuffle tracking and queue handoff compatibility.
- No intentional breaking changes to persisted Home Assistant configuration, device registration, or app protocol.

## Review and verification

This is a **release-candidate preparation**, not a published release. Validate native Home Assistant icon appearance, HACS installation and CI before approving publication.

## Companion compatibility

PowerPlay 1.4.0+ supports existing PowerShuffle features; PowerPlay 2.0.0 will introduce the matching app branding.
